submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. Written in `do`-notation on `Plinth.Validator`, an early-termination monad, together with the typed decoding DSL `Plinth.Decoder.Named`: each `ScriptContext` field is decoded with a single `Constr` walk, and a value that is only compared is never structurally decoded (`Plinth.Encoded`). The validator finds the escrow output with a module-local unique lookup and reads ADA with `assetAmount`. Compiled with Plinth 1.64.0.0. Inliner budget: `inline-unconditional-growth=28`, kept from revision 1 and not swept again. The plain implementation of this line is `Plinth_1.64.0.0_Unisay_plain`.
